objective: Preserve the full spatial frequency grid while reducing portable payload bytes through deterministic per-token scalar quantization

representation.longitudinal: nearest graph sample with 1.25 voxel tangent half-length cap
representation.quantization: deterministic per-token scale or affine scale-plus-offset

selection: Smallest encoded bytes per token with mean equal-volume IoU >= 0.70 and no more than 0.02 below FULL_33; ties prefer simpler symmetric decoding

gate.morphology: beats fitted single-radius sweep by 3-of-4 and negative mean-log distance on at least 4 of 5 whole-cave folds
gate.volume: zero-threshold median candidate/reference ratio in [0.8, 1.25] on at least 4 of 5 folds

promotion_limit: Quantization only establishes a compact deterministic compiler payload; learned inference generalization remains a CW7 question
claim_limit: five burned development caves; target-derived compiler oracle only
